tasks.title: M0 §4.2a — supabase init + foundation migration: tenancy core, helpers, RLS (DAVIN)
tasks.description:
Owner: DAVIN. Milestone: M0 §4.2 (part 1 of 3). Spec: PLAN.md §4.2, CLAUDE.md "Multi-tenancy" and "Domain model".

Why: PLAN.md says supabase/config.toml exists. It doesn't (main has docs only). This task creates it and the core schema that every other M0 task builds on. No dependency on the Next.js scaffold, so start now.

Branded confirm-signup and reset-password templates in supabase/templates/ that link to `{{ .SiteURL }}/auth/confirm?token_hash={{ .TokenHash }}&type=…&next=…`.
2. Migration `…_foundation_core.sql`:
   - Schema `private` (not exposed). Shared `private.set_updated_at()` trigger on every table with updated_at.
   - Tables: profiles (id = auth.users.id; trigger on auth.users insert creates it; email sync on update), platform_admins (only service role writes it), packages, organizations (slug check `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{1,38})[a-z0-9]$`; status active|suspended|past_due|read_only; currency default 'IDR'; timezone default 'Asia/Jakarta'), reserved_slugs (seeded in the migration: www, app, admin, api, demo, mail, …), subscriptions, locations (tax_rate_bps, service_charge_bps, tax_on_service_charge, integer bps, no floats), permissions (catalog: insert the 23 keys from PLAN §4.2), default_role_permissions (insert the Manager/Cashier/Waiter/Kitchen templates from the PLAN table; Owner is implicit), roles (per org, is_system, key), role_permissions, organization_members (status active|deactivated, all_locations), location_staff, org_branding, audit_logs (org nullable), platform_settings.
   - Text + CHECK constraints, not enums. Every tenant table: organization_id NOT NULL + index. Money: bigint minor units + currency.
   - Helpers (security definer, `set search_path = ''`, stable): is_platform_admin(), is_org_member(org), has_permission(org, perm) (owner role ⇒ true for every perm; deactivated members ⇒ false), has_location_access(location) (all_locations or location_staff), my_permissions(org) → text[], private.org_limit(org, key) (from the active subscription's package limits), private.write_audit(...).
   - RLS enabled on **every** public table; policies use `(select auth.uid())` and the helpers. No `using (true)` on tenant data. packages: anon/auth can read rows where is_active and is_public; writes = platform admin. reserved_slugs/permissions: read-only for authenticated. platform_admins: no client access except "is it me".
   - Revoke execute on private.* from anon/authenticated; grant only what's needed on public helpers.
3. Functional pgTAP tests in supabase/tests/database/: helpers return the right values for owner/manager/cashier/deactivated/non-member; every public table has RLS enabled (query pg_class); slug check rejects bad slugs.
Not in this task: staff_invitations + RPCs (MF-T03), limit/owner/system-role triggers (MF-T04), seed (MF-T05). REYKI writes the cross-tenant isolation tests against this spec in supabase/tests/isolation/ (parallel task); don't add files there.

tasks.title: M0 §4.2b — staff_invitations + RPCs (create_organization, accept_invitation, …) (DAVIN)
tasks.description:
Owner: DAVIN. Milestone: M0 §4.2 (part 2 of 3). Blocked by MF-T02.

Build a new migration `…_foundation_rpcs.sql` (never edit T02's migration once merged):
- Table staff_invitations: organization_id, email (citext or lower()), role_id, location_ids uuid[], token_hash (SHA-256 hex, unique), invited_by, expires_at (default now()+7d), accepted_at, revoked_at, send_count, timestamps. RLS: select/insert/update only with has_permission(org,'staff.manage'). Never expose token_hash to clients (column privileges, or a view without it).
- RPCs (security definer, search_path = '', validate every arg, raise clear error codes):
  - is_slug_available(slug) → boolean. Grant anon + authenticated. False for reserved, taken, or invalid format.
  - create_organization(name, slug, location jsonb {name, address, city, phone, timezone, currency, tax_rate_bps, service_charge_bps, tax_on_service_charge}, branding jsonb default null {primary_color, logo_url}, package_code text default null) → {organization_id, slug}. ONE transaction: org, 5 system roles (owner, manager, cashier, waiter, kitchen) with role_permissions copied from default_role_permissions, owner membership (all_locations = true) for auth.uid(), first location, org_branding row, trialing subscription on the given public+active package or the is_default one (trial_ends_at = now() + trial_days), audit entry. Caps owned orgs per user (default 3, overridable from platform_settings). Authenticated only; requires a confirmed email.
  - accept_invitation(token text) → {organization_id, slug}. Hashes the raw token in SQL (extensions.digest), checks not expired, not revoked, not accepted, and that lower(invite email) = lower(auth.jwt() ->> 'email'). Creates/reactivates the membership with the invited role, sets location_staff rows, marks accepted_at, writes audit. Same error for "not found" and "wrong email" so tokens can't be probed.
  - get_invitation_preview(token text) → {restaurant_name, role_name, email_hint (masked, e.g. c***@demo.local), expired boolean} or null. Grant anon + authenticated. Looks up by hash only; returns nothing else (no ids, no full email). Used by the /invite page before sign-in.
  - get_storefront(slug) → public org info (name, slug), branding, active locations (name, address, city, phone, timezone) — ONLY when org.status = 'active'; for suspended return {status:'unavailable'} without other data. Grant anon. No emails, no IDs beyond what the storefront needs.
  - admin_set_org_status(org, status, reason) → void. Only is_platform_admin(); writes audit_logs with the admin's id and reason.
- pgTAP tests in supabase/tests/database/ for the happy paths and argument validation of each RPC. REYKI covers abuse cases (wrong email, expired, reused, cross-tenant) in isolation/.

tasks.description:
Owner: DAVIN. Milestone: M0 §4.2 "Triggers" (part 3 of 3). Blocked by MF-T03 (staff_invitations must exist for its limit trigger).

New migration `…_foundation_triggers.sql`:

- Make sure create_organization (T03) still works with these triggers (the first owner membership and first location must pass).
- pgTAP tests in supabase/tests/database/ for each trigger, including the boundary (exactly at cap succeeds, cap+1 fails).

tasks.title: M0 §4.5d — lib/money.ts: currency exponent, formatting, tax + service charge (DAVIN)
tasks.description:
Owner: DAVIN. Milestone: M0 §4.5 (money.ts). Pure module, no DB.

**Binding signature for UI callers (agreed with ADIT on 2026-11-08):** `formatMoney(amount: number, currency: string, locale?: string): string`, where amount is a safe integer in minor units; `formatMoney(25000, 'IDR')` → 'Rp 25.000'. Money stays `number` (safe integer, guarded with Number.isSafeInteger) throughout lib/money.ts. Postgres bigint arrives as a JS number via supabase-js, and IDR values never approach 2^53.

Build apps/web/lib/money.ts per CLAUDE.md "Money, tax and time":
- Never floats on money; non-integer input throws.
- `currencyExponent(code)`: IDR 0, USD 2 (extendable table).
- `formatMoney(amount, currency, locale = 'id-ID')` → `Rp 25.000` for IDR 25000; USD 2550 → `$25.50` with en-US.
- `calculateBill({ subtotal, serviceChargeBps, taxRateBps, taxOnServiceCharge = true })` → { subtotal, serviceCharge, tax, total }. Service charge first, then tax on (subtotal + service charge) unless taxOnServiceCharge is false. Rates in basis points (1000 = 10%). Integer-only maths; one documented rounding rule.
- `allocate(amount, parts)` for equal splits that always sum back to the total (remainder spread from the first part).
- Vitest: table tests for IDR and USD, zero rates, 10% PB1 + 5% service, tax not on service charge, rounding edges (e.g. 33333 × 10%), allocate sums, rejecting non-integers.

tasks.title: M0 §4.5e — lib/payments/doku/signature.ts: Non-SNAP signing + verification (ADIT, moved from DAVIN)
tasks.description:
Owner: **ADIT** (moved from DAVIN on 2026-11-08 with the user's approval, to rebalance load; a one-time ownership exception for this file). Milestone: M0 §4.5 (DOKU signature: built early because it's small and pure; the rest of DOKU is M5). No dependencies beyond the scaffold.

Build apps/web/lib/payments/doku/signature.ts (import 'server-only'), per CLAUDE.md "DOKU request signing (Non-SNAP)":
- `digest(rawBody: string)` = base64(sha256(rawBody)).
- `buildComponent({ clientId, requestId, requestTimestamp, requestTarget, digest? })`: omit the Digest line for GET (no body).
- `sign(component, secretKey)` → `HMACSHA256=` + base64(hmac-sha256).
- `signRequest({ clientId, secretKey, requestTarget, body?, requestId?, now? })` → headers { Client-Id, Request-Id, Request-Timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC, no ms, `Z`), Signature }.
- `verifyNotification({ headers, rawBody, path, secretKey })` → boolean; constant-time compare (crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers; unequal length → false without throwing); header names case-insensitive.
- Use node:crypto. Never log secrets or full headers.
- Vitest with DOKU's documented example vector. **docs.doku.com is not on the sandbox allow-list**: call request_access for docs.doku.com and meanwhile write the tests from the formula plus an independently computed vector (`openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac … -binary | base64`), then swap in the documented vector once access is granted. Say in the PR which vector you used.

- [ ] verifyNotification: valid → true; one-byte body change, wrong secret, wrong path, missing header, different-length signature → false, never throws
- [ ] Constant-time compare used
- [ ] Module is server-only; no secrets logged
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes

tasks.title: M0 §4.6a — auth Server Actions + /auth/confirm route handler (DAVIN)
tasks.description:
Owner: DAVIN. Milestone: M0 §4.6 (backend half). Blocked by MF-T07 (DAL) and MF-T08 (Arcjet presets).

ADIT builds the pages (MF-T14, PR #27) against this contract in parallel. **Binding contract, agreed with ADIT on 2026-11-08; don't change it without telling ADIT and ALAN:**
```ts
// apps/web/lib/auth/schemas.ts: Zod schemas shared by forms and actions
export type ActionErrorCode = 'PLAN_LIMIT' | 'LAST_OWNER' | 'SYSTEM_ROLE' | 'ALREADY_INVITED' | 'INVALID_INVITATION' | 'FORBIDDEN' | 'RATE_LIMITED';
export type ActionResult =
  | { ok: true }
  | { ok: false; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string[]>; formError?: string; code?: ActionErrorCode };
// apps/web/lib/auth/actions.ts ('use server'); every form action has the useActionState shape:
signIn(prev: ActionResult | null, formData: FormData): Promise<ActionResult>          // reads `next` from a hidden field
signUp(prev: ActionResult | null, formData: FormData): Promise<ActionResult>          // also reads a hidden `next` (default /onboarding)
requestPasswordReset(prev: ActionResult | null, formData: FormData): Promise<ActionResult>
updatePassword(prev: ActionResult | null, formData: FormData): Promise<ActionResult>
signOut(): Promise<void>                                                              // redirects to /login
```

Build:
- `signIn`: Arcjet `ajAuth`. On success redirect to a validated `next` (same-origin relative paths only) or `/`.
- `signUp` (fullName, email, password ≥ 10 chars, optional next): Arcjet `ajSignup` (email validation). Calls supabase.auth.signUp with emailRedirectTo `${NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/auth/confirm?next={validated next or /onboarding}`, so an invitee who signs up via `/signup?next=/invite/{token}` lands back on the invite page after confirming. Captures `signup_started` (no PII). Returns ok → page shows "check your email". Same response whether or not the email already exists (no account enumeration).
- `requestPasswordReset`: ajAuth; always returns ok (no enumeration); redirect link → /auth/confirm?next=/reset-password.
- `updatePassword`: requires a session (from the recovery link).
- `signOut()`: clears the session, redirects to /login.
- Route handler apps/web/app/(auth)/auth/confirm/route.ts: verifyOtp({ type, token_hash }), then redirect to the validated `next`; on failure redirect to /login?error=link_expired. On type=signup success, capture `signup_completed`.
- Map Supabase/Arcjet errors to friendly messages; never echo raw provider errors.
- Vitest: open-redirect guard for `next` (absolute URLs, //evil.com, /\\evil.com rejected; /invite/{token} allowed), Zod schemas.
